generic_macro_bench.name: Generic macro bench
generic_macro_bench.description: Top-down HSI camera, oblique tunable lamp, a mixed set of fluorescent samples on a black anodized stage — including a brightened paper card as a confound.

mehsi_lab_replica.name: ME-HSI lab replica (TLS + Nuance)
mehsi_lab_replica.description: 8-line tunable light source 310–430 nm and a Nuance-class LCTF camera (348×256, 31 bands from 420 nm, 10 nm step), three lichen thalli on black stage.

led_multispectral.name: LED multispectral bench
led_multispectral.description: Six-channel LED array next to a filter-wheel sCMOS camera.

laser_line.name: Laser-line cuvettes (90° geometry)
laser_line.description: Classic fluorometer geometry: a laser beam through a row of cuvettes, viewed at 90°.

layered_wedge_phantom.name: Layered wedge phantom
layered_wedge_phantom.description: Fluorescein layer (0.5 mm) on a turbid substrate, under a turbid cover that thins linearly from 2 mm to 0 across the block. Solved with the 3D layered Monte Carlo.

tissue_under_collagen.name: Tissue under collagen (wedge)
tissue_under_collagen.description: NADH/FAD tissue layer under a collagen cover thinning from 1.5 mm to 50 µm, on a turbid substrate; lab TLS + Nuance hardware. 3D layered Monte Carlo.

pencil_beam_penetration.name: Pencil-beam penetration (tissue + collagen)
pencil_beam_penetration.description: 1 mm laser beam at 45° into a tissue block under 0.5 mm of collagen: visualise the banana-shaped 3D light field and the scattering-broadened fluorescence spot.

skin_three_layer.name: Skin three-layer (epidermis / dermis / subcutis)
skin_three_layer.description: Literature-parameterised skin: melanosome-absorbing epidermis, blood-perfused dermis (NADH/FAD/collagen/elastin autofluorescence), fatty subcutis. 3D layered Monte Carlo.

mucosa_dysplasia_inclusion.name: Mucosa with buried dysplastic nodule
mucosa_dysplasia_inclusion.description: Colon mucosa over submucosa and muscle with a buried 0.7 mm NADH-rich dysplastic nodule: can the TLS + Nuance chain see a metabolic lesion through 0.45 mm of mucosa?

vessel_under_collagen.name: Blood vessel under collagen
vessel_under_collagen.description: Cylindrical blood vessel (0.4 mm) in reticular dermis under a 0.5 mm dense-collagen cover: light absorbed by oxy-haemoglobin attenuates the autofluorescence above it.
